title: Great idea...
text: Great idea.... Thought this was great until I tried it. It doesn't hold air that well. It slowly deflates when pressure is put on it. I am kind of disappointed. But others may like it.

product_metadata.title: Inflatable Travel Pillow, Inflatable Neck Air Pillow for Sleeping, Support Head, Chin, Neck and Lumbar, Avoid Neck and Shoulder Pain, Comfortable for Airplane, Car, Bus, Train and Office Napping
features: [More comfortable] No chemical smell. With soft and comfortable fabric, MYFON travel pillow makes head and neck blood circulation improved obviously. No more sleepless through long trips. Love to sleep through long trips.
[Perfect Design] Perfect 45° angle design. Let head and neck well support when sleep with sitting posture. Easier to fall asleep and sleep better.
[Leakage Prevention] 100% air leakage test for each product. Test time is 72 hours, base on highest industry standard.
[Applicable For] Traveler. Office staff. Sleepless. People who can't sleep because of stress.
[Portable] It can be deflated and put in the storage bag. Make it small and light to be carried easily.
description: Keeping your head and neck supported while traveling. Improving comfort and safety. Help to make your traveling experience less stressful and painful. Getting a good nights sleep.
